description: Generate framework-aware fix alternatives for a specific accessibility issue. For color contrast issues, returns 3 alternatives (minimal, brand-aligned, high contrast); brand palette is auto-extracted from the live URL using our scanner if `brandColors` is omitted. For label/ARIA issues, returns 1-2 alternatives. Each alternative includes ready-to-paste code for the detected framework. NOTE: on this HOSTED server, localhost and private addresses are refused — it runs in our cloud and cannot reach your machine. Two ways to scan a local dev server: run the MCP locally (`npx -y @webability/mcp`, simplest — nothing leaves the machine), or open a tunnel (`webability-tunnel --port 3000`) and pass its URL as `url` together with the printed secret as `tunnel_secret`.

brandColors.description: Brand palette for brand-aligned suggestions. If omitted on a contrast issue with a `url`, auto-extracted via the scanner.

context.description: Parent element outerHTML for context (~400 chars)

html.description: The element's outerHTML — send at most ~600 chars

issue.description: Issue object from scan_page (with selector, wcag, impact, message, fix.currentValue), or a plain-text issue description

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

tunnel_secret.description: Secret printed by `webability-tunnel`. Required when `url` is a tunnel URL; the URL alone will be refused by the relay. Ignored otherwise.

url.description: Page URL — also used to auto-extract brand palette for contrast issues if `brandColors` is not provided.

name: generate_ai_fix
title: Suggest a framework-aware fix
